peerGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (CCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

positions.label: Price position
positions.statement: Price position — In line with comparable condos: 4.8% above its local comparables; 96 of 144 similar developments with a figure have a lower relative price (a position, not a measure of value).

positions.label: Resale activity
positions.statement: Resale activity — Around peers (57.2): 3.2 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months): higher than 228 of 405 similar developments with a figure (the same as 7). Context, not scored: resales in 45.8% of months (24 months).

comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (CCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments
lines.statement: 1-bedroom: median $1,330,000 ($2,331 psf, 570 sq ft; 5 resales, Jul 2024–Jun 2026); 8 comparable developments within 3 km: median $2,014 psf (range $1,840–2,330); 15.8% above; illustrative entry-price difference about $181,000 more. 3-bedroom: median $3,700,188 ($2,359 psf, 1,227–1,743 sq ft; 9 resales, Oct 2024–Sep 2026); 8 comparable developments within 3 km: median $2,515 psf (range $2,264–2,886); 6.2% below; illustrative entry-price difference about $245,000 less. The entry-price difference is illustrative: the median price adjusted to the comparable median psf, for a similar-size unit. A premium or a discount is not in itself an advantage or a disadvantage.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity
lines.statement: No first resale wave in the observation period: sustained activity is the observed activity.

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Great World MRT about 150 m, Havelock MRT about 200 m; closer than 504 of 551 similar developments (the same as 3). Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 1 within 1 km and 4 within 2 km; nearest River Valley Primary School about 300 m; more than 107 of 551 similar developments (the same as 202). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 12 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 300 m), more than 539 of 551 similar developments (the same as 5); nearest hawker centre Zion Riverside Food Centre about 340 m; nearest park Pearl's Hill City Park about 840 m. Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Not yet assessed: needs official LTA evidence for planned stations.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 8 other condo developments sold new homes within 2 km (Promenade Peak, 99 new sales, about 130 m; River Modern, 431 new sales, about 150 m; Zyon Grand, 637 new sales, about 170 m; River Green, 34 new sales, about 330 m; The Avenir, 1 new sales, about 380 m; Hill House, 5 new sales, about 710 m; The Robertson Opus, 40 new sales, about 790 m; Grange 1866, 6 new sales, about 1,060 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 314 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 1,448 new sales and 1,171 resales (2,619 purchases); new sales were 55.3% of these purchases. Subsales (41) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.label: Unsold inventory

missing.reason: not available until the URA-based launched-unsold measure (S3) passes the V1 local validation; no other inventory source is used

lines.statement: Not available: unsold inventory has not been validated.

lines.label: Known pipeline

missing.reason: known sites only; not a complete pipeline

lines.statement: Within 2 km: upcoming Sophia Meadow development, about 1,820 m. Known sites only; not a complete pipeline.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Not a quiet area. 1,171 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 429 of 551 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 1,171 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 1,359 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−13.8%). Planning-area private resales −25.5%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
